description:
## Problem
Six user-facing pages in `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` describe the released `published-results` PR target: `docs/contributing-results.md`, `docs/reference/cli/submit.md`, `docs/guides/hosted-submission.md`, `docs/reference/hosted-results-contract.md`, `docs/operations/uat-framework.md`, and `docs/operations/uat-methodology.md` (plus `docs/development/adr/adr-published-identifier-field-set.md`).

## Change (Step 4 of 6)
Update those pages on `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` `next` to describe the `develop` bundle submission workflow and manual-review guard, marked for the release that ships Step 3 so they reach `main` through the normal release documentation PR.
